playNote(60, beats=2, velocity=volume)

playNote(53, beats=0.5, velocity=volume)
playNote(53, beats=0.5, velocity=volume)

rest(2) 

#loop back to the first melody 
volume = 60
for i in range(4):
    playNote(55, beats=0.5, velocity=volume)
playNote(65, beats=1, velocity=volume)
playNote(64,beats=0.5,velocity=volume) 
playNote(55,beats=1.5,velocity=volume) 
# Repeat lower note three times
for i in range(3):
    playNote(52, beats=1, velocity=volume)

# Create a reusable calming melody function
def calming_pattern():
    velocity=volume 
    playNote(60, beats=1, velocity=60)
    playNote(62, beats=1, velocity=60)
    playNote(64, beats=2, velocity=60)
    playNote(62, beats=1, velocity=60)
# Play the calming pattern
#lines 42-44 define the melody but line 47 calls the function.
calming_pattern()
# The function creates a reusable melody by grouping four musical notes together this can then be played by calling the function, reducing repeated code and making the composition more efficient.
